text: The quality of your life is the quality of your thoughts, compounded daily.
author: Quality of Thought

text: You can't always choose what happens to you, but you can always choose what you do with it next.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Begin where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
author: Arthur Ashe

text: Small steps, repeated daily, outrun big plans that never start.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Doubt is a signal to look closer, not a reason to look away.
author: Quality of Thought

text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
author: Proverb

text: Be patient with yourself. Nothing in nature blooms all year.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Clarity comes from action, not from thinking about action.
author: Quality of Thought

text: A calm mind is a quiet advantage.
author: Quality of Thought

text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
author: Nelson Mandela

text: Ask better questions and your thoughts will give better answers.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Progress is quiet. Don't mistake silence for stillness.
author: Quality of Thought

text: What you pay attention to grows. Choose your focus like you choose your friends.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
author: Japanese proverb

text: Your next thought is a decision. Make it a good one.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the decision that something else matters more.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Today's discomfort is tomorrow's strength.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Do not wait for confidence. Act, and confidence will catch up.
author: Quality of Thought

text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Lao Tzu

text: Think deeply, speak kindly, act bravely.
author: Quality of Thought

text: You are allowed to change your mind. That's what learning looks like.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Don't count the days. Make the days count.
author: Muhammad Ali

text: Rest is part of the work, not a reward for finishing it.
author: Quality of Thought

text: A good question is worth more than a quick answer.
author: Quality of Thought

text: You don't have to see the whole staircase. Just take the first step.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: Your habits are votes for the person you are becoming.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Kindness to yourself is not weakness. It's maintenance.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Keep going. Hard things are hard for everyone; the difference is who stays.
author: Quality of Thought

text: What we think, we become.
author: Buddha (attributed)

text: Perfect is the enemy of shipped.
author: Quality of Thought

text: The obstacle is the way.
author: Marcus Aurelius (paraphrased)

text: Curiosity is the engine of a good life. Keep it running.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Every expert was once a beginner who refused to quit.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Let your effort be louder than your excuses.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Worry borrows tomorrow's trouble and spends it today. Decline the loan.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Be the kind of person your future self thanks.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: Slow down. Most of what feels urgent isn't important.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Listen to understand, not to reply.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Your story isn't over; this is just a chapter.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Start before you feel ready. Readiness is built by starting.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Choose the thought that serves you, not the one that scares you.
author: Quality of Thought

text: A mistake is only a failure if you refuse to learn from it.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Light a candle instead of cursing the dark.
author: Proverb

text: Your pace doesn't matter. Your direction does.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Joy is found in the ordinary if you slow down enough to notice.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Be stubborn about your goals and flexible about your methods.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Today is a blank page. Write something you'd be proud to reread.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Strong minds are built in quiet moments, not loud ones.
author: Quality of Thought

text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Challenge your assumptions; they are the walls of your world.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Done is better than perfect, and begun is better than done.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Treat each day as a fresh draft, not a final copy.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Hope is a discipline: practice it daily.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Plant seeds today in the garden you'll walk through next year.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Think clearly. Act simply. Repeat.
author: Quality of Thought

text: You are more capable than your worst day suggests.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Stay curious, stay humble, stay moving.
author: Quality of Thought

text: Be a student of your own mind.
author: Quality of Thought
